checks.claim: One inch of rain on a 1,000 square foot roof is over 600 gallons of water.
checks.why: The geometric figure is about 623 gallons (0.623 gallons per square foot per inch); utilities round to 620. 'Over 600 gallons' is safe.

sources.title: Las Virgenes Municipal Water District rain barrel guide

checks.claim: Asphalt shingles are the most common roofing material on US homes
checks.why: Industry sources put them on about 70 to 85 percent of US homes, far ahead of metal.

sources.title: Roofing Market Trends - Home Innovation Research Labs

checks.claim: Shingles are laid from the bottom edge up, each row overlapping the one below.
checks.why: IKO and Fine Homebuilding describe a starter course at the eave and courses above covering and staggering the joints below.
